name: Yanagihara Tomo
source: Competitor for the title of Miss Houjou and rival of Setsuna. She isn’t afraid to bend situations to her advantage, using her charm and wits whenever it suits her.
translation: Competitor for the title of Miss Houjou and rival of Setsuna. She isn’t afraid to bend situations to her advantage, using her charm and wits whenever it suits her.
